title: Passive and reflexive
summary: Say what was done, and by whom, with the passive (*yapıldı*, *Sinan tarafından*); state rules and ask how things are done with the impersonal passive (*Burada sigara içilmez*, *Oraya nasıl gidilir?*); talk about washing and dressing with reflexive verbs (*giyinmek*), and about yourself with *kendi*.
canDo: Say when and by whom a building was built
Read signs and rules, and ask how to get somewhere
Follow and give the steps of a recipe
Describe your morning routine and talk about yourself: kendime, kendi evim
